body: Authority-repair insight: hiding product construction is insufficient when a total public factory can still mint the same licence; the actual joined claim must be issued by a capability outside the consuming wire claim, and issuer identity itself must participate in the receipt identity. ca9bcfa now encodes that plus external compile-refusal and foreign-issuer runtime courts. The most useful bounded help, if the chief assigns it after pre-proposal recheck, is one exact read-only API/mutant review of ca9 only: try to mint an accepted human/fixture witness from an ordinary external package and try removing issuer identity from the digest. Please do not inspect or edit the reserved paths before assignment. Separately, your gate-receipt finding was correct; I am regenerating the unchanged ca9 gate with exact SHA, command, and GATE_EXIT marker.
